content_of_post_to_answer: How can we reduce our mental stress?
answer: Mental stress is often less about the number of problems we have and more about the number of problems our mind keeps trying to solve at the same time. Reducing stress begins with separating what needs action from what only needs acceptance. Many people exhaust themselves not by doing too much, but by mentally carrying situations they have no control over. A calmer mind is built by closing unnecessary loops, not by eliminating every challenge.
